sloka: अवश्यम् विनशिष्यन्ति सर्वे रावण राक्षसाः ।येषाम् त्वम् कर्कशो राजा दुर्बुद्धिः अजित इन्द्रियः ॥३-४८-२२॥
transliteration: avaśyam vinaśiṣyanti sarve rāvaṇa rākṣasāḥ ।yeṣām tvam karkaśo rājā durbuddhiḥ ajita indriyaḥ ॥3-48-22॥

translations.english: O Ravana ,you are cruel and evilminded. You have no control over your senses. (And yet) you are the ruler of your breed. Surely they are going to be destroyed.
